preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 4 * 10**5 for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 1 and 4 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= m <= 4 * 10**5 for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges m is between 0 and 4 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for n, m, edges in test_cases for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in a test case, both vertices a_i and b_i are between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, m in test_cases) <= 4 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 4 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: sum(m for n, m in test_cases) <= 4 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of m over all test cases does not exceed 4 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result) == n for result, (n, m, edges) in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: The length of the result for each test case is equal to the number of vertices n.

postconditions.expression: all(value in {-1, 0, 1, 2} for result in results for value in result)
postconditions.description: Each value in the result for each test case is one of {-1, 0, 1, 2}.

postconditions.expression: all((value == 0) == (num_paths == 0) for result, (n, m, edges) in zip(results, test_cases) for value, num_paths in zip(result, num_paths_from_1))
postconditions.description: The value is 0 if and only if there are no paths from vertex 1 to the vertex.

postconditions.expression: all((value == 1) == (num_paths == 1) for result, (n, m, edges) in zip(results, test_cases) for value, num_paths in zip(result, num_paths_from_1))
postconditions.description: The value is 1 if and only if there is exactly one path from vertex 1 to the vertex.

postconditions.expression: all((value == 2) == (num_paths > 1 and num_paths < float('inf')) for result, (n, m, edges) in zip(results, test_cases) for value, num_paths in zip(result, num_paths_from_1))
postconditions.description: The value is 2 if and only if there are more than one but a finite number of paths from vertex 1 to the vertex.

postconditions.expression: all((value == -1) == (num_paths == float('inf')) for result, (n, m, edges) in zip(results, test_cases) for value, num_paths in zip(result, num_paths_from_1))
postconditions.description: The value is -1 if and only if there are an infinite number of paths from vertex 1 to the vertex.
